description: SteelMC (Steel): Minecraft: Java Edition server written in Rust, tracking the latest Java release (26.3). Lock-free, multicore design. Pre-alpha.
notes: Start it from 'Scoop Apps' > 'SteelMC (Minecraft server)', or with the command 'steel' in a console.
Both run it in its data folder, so settings, worlds and logs land in
%USERPROFILE%\scoop\persist\SteelMC\server: they survive updates, and only 'scoop uninstall -p' deletes them.
Stop the server with its 'stop' console command before 'scoop update' or 'scoop uninstall'.
Windows Firewall asks on the first start, and again after each update (the exe moves to a new folder).
Every server listens on port 25565 by default: run one at a time, or change the port in its config.
Pre-alpha: survival mechanics and mobs are incomplete, there is no plugin system, and no Bukkit, Paper or (Neo)Forge support.
Upstream ships no Windows ARM64 build.

script: # The server works in the current folder, so the command and the shortcut start it in the persisted 'server' folder.
':: SteelMC: starts the server; /PAUSE (used by the Scoop Apps shortcut) keeps the window open when it stops.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
':: Only the shortcut''s own window gets a title; a console that runs the command keeps its title.',
'ECHO SteelMC: Minecraft Java Edition server written in Rust (pre-alpha).',
'ECHO Settings, worlds and logs: persist\SteelMC\server in your Scoop folder.',
'ECHO Players connect to this computer on port 25565 unless the server config says otherwise.',
'ECHO Type stop and press Enter to stop the server.',
':: The server reads and writes its files in the current folder: the persisted "server" folder.',
